استنصروا (form X)
# اِسْتَنْصَرُوا (istanṣarū) /is.tan.sˤa.ruː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِسْتَنْصَرَ (istanṣara)
# اُسْتُنْصِرُوا (ustunṣirū) /us.tun.sˤi.ruː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِسْتَنْصَرَ (istanṣara)
# اِسْتَنْصِرُوا (istanṣirū) /is.tan.sˤi.ruː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِسْتَنْصَرَ (istanṣara)
